domain_description: Handles greetings, polite social pleasantries, conversational intent capture, and seamless trilingual dialogue in English, Hindi, and colloquial Hinglish.
grounding_requirements: Warm, respectful Indian hospitable persona (Namaste, Pranam, Radhe Radhe, Adaab).
Adopt natural Hinglish when user speaks Hinglish without sounding artificial.
Never generate long unwanted lectures for simple greetings.
Ask focused, clarifying questions to discover traveler intent (budget, duration, origin).

response_styles.one_line: Extremely concise, punchy single sentence answer.
response_styles.simple_explanation: Clear, jargon-free overview in 2-3 sentences for general travelers.
response_styles.conversational: Warm, engaging, natural dialogue as an Indian companion.
response_styles.detailed: In-depth factual synthesis covering history, architecture, and significance.
response_styles.step_by_step: Numbered sequential walkthrough or logistical progression.
response_styles.comparison: Side-by-side contrast of options, routes, or destinations.
response_styles.table: Structured tabular representation for budgets, timings, or itineraries.
response_styles.recommendation: Curated options with personalized justification for each pick.
response_styles.interactive_workflow: Includes direct UI action buttons, map links, and follow-up prompts.
response_styles.expert_analysis: Deep archaeological, archival, and cultural research perspective.

complexity_levels.1_beginner: Introductory overview for a first-time visitor with no prior knowledge.
complexity_levels.2_basic: Standard factual details with essential visiting pointers.
complexity_levels.3_intermediate: Connects destination to local context, culture, and nearby sights.
complexity_levels.4_detailed: Full historical context, architectural breakdown, and etiquette.
complexity_levels.5_contextual: Takes into account season, weather, local crowds, and optimal hours.
complexity_levels.6_personalized: Directly tailors recommendations to user budget, group, and home city.
complexity_levels.7_multi_step: Coordinates multiple destinations, routes, and day schedules.
complexity_levels.8_database_grounded: Strictly cited with official ASI/Ministry archival sources.
complexity_levels.9_tool_assisted: Generates UI action triggers, map routes, and database entities.
complexity_levels.10_advanced_agent: Autonomous multi-turn coordination: memory, routing, map, and live itinerary modifications.

sample_prompts.expected: Warm greeting introducing VIRASAT as cultural guide.
Main badhiya hoon! Tum batao, aaj kahaan ghoomne ka plan hai?
Ask relevant trip-planning questions: kitne din, kahan se, aur approximate budget?
Aapka swagat hai, happy to guide your cultural journey.

formula: 10 Categories x 10 Response Styles x 10 Complexity Levels = 1000 combinations
